The exterior of the ashcloak is thickly caked with layer upon layer of grit, soot and dust.  Set against the mottled greys and blacks is a tiny, pyramid-shaped clasp of inscribed rhodochrosite.
The bright red gems are linked together on a silversteel mesh cape and draped over the shoulders of the long cloak, their faceted surfaces capturing and reflecting all available light in a fiery array of color.  Finishing the design is a pyramid-shaped rhodochrosite clasp set at the throat.

Speckles of red congregate in the creature's mane, giving it a chaotic look compared to the rest of the grey-black cambrinth.  The beast's jaws hang open, razor sharp glaes fangs bared in a fearsome snarl.  The rimewolf's eyes are made of Elven gold the pale yellow color of sulfur, looking not unlike the yellowed planet Misueshi.  The rimewolf is the symbol of Misiumos, Albarian goddess of ice.

items.name: a rugged leather archer's armguard lined with emerald silk
items.tap: a rugged leather archer's armguard lined with emerald silk
items.description: This comfortable bracer is designed to allow free movement of the wrist while providing ample protection of the forearm from string slap.  Dark cross-grain leather runs from just below the elbow to the index finger and thumb when worn and is layered with tawny leather along the inner forearm for additional reinforcement.  Steel eyelets along the outer arm are laced with brown cording to secure the armpiece, fastened at the end with an ebony toggle. | An inconspicuous tag reads, "Limited Tre" but is smudged and indecipherable beyond that.

items.name: a short fractalline dress with uneven hemline
items.tap: a short fractalline dress with uneven hemline
items.description: The soft, cotton fabric features a unique pattern of subtle ivory whorls intertwined with vibrant prismatic fractals woven throughout.  This whimsical garment showcases a fitted bodice with a sweetheart neckline and a handkerchief skirt.  The skirt consists of three gathered layers that culminate in an uneven hemline, which is beautifully edged with a shiny blue ribbon.  Additionally, faceted gems along the slender waistline enhance the dress's shine and sparkle.

items.name: a short tamboti plank
items.description: The fragrant, dense wood is a reddish-brown hue reminiscent of dried blood and holds a satin-like lustre.

items.name: a side-laced crimson corset hand sewn from supple kidskin beaded in black onyx
a silversteel jousting shield with glaes spikes
items.tap: a silversteel jousting shield with glaes spikes
items.description: A lidless eyeball wreathed in glaes brambles adorns the shield's face.  Sharp spikes jut haphazardly from the scene, somehow acheiving a balance complimenting the competitive design.

items.name: a sleek ebony leather bodice beaded with silver and moonstone
items.tap: a sleek ebony leather bodice beaded with silver and moonstone
items.description: A delicate beaded pattern of silver vines tipped with moonstone starflowers twines around over the front panels, neatly concealing the slender bone stays beneath.  Knotted strands of silk lace up the back of the bodice, cinching the front boning firmly for a snug fit.

items.name: a slender ironrot quarterstaff surmounted with a princess-cut temptress beryl
items.tap: a slender ironrot quarterstaff surmounted with a princess-cut temptress beryl
items.description: Fashioned as twisted regalia of corruption, the sleek black wood glistens like an oil slick with irregular blotches of dark green and purple marring the surface, perfectly complementing the apex amethyst stone with a spiraled green inclusion at the core that seems to shift and swirl hypnotically when viewed from various angles.

items.name: a smokewood latchbow with a carved stock
items.tap: a smokewood latchbow with a carved stock
items.description: A line of stylized trowels and picks ornaments the grey wood stock which has been further embellished with inlaid platinum forming the metal parts of the designs.  The same design of tools has been engraved into the springy steel of the prod, picked out with more platinum.

items.name: a spiked vardite axe with a silver-inlaid blade
items.tap: a spiked vardite axe with a silver-inlaid blade
items.description: The striped yellow wood of the zingana handle contrasts with the dark orange metal of the axehead.  Scrollwork has been inlaid in the blade's head in narrow bands of silver.

items.name: a webbed araneium bracer

Where the twisted strands are nearly hidden, the shadows are unnervingly inert, but areas under any illumination reveal a network of glimmering filaments just beneath the surface, seeming to slide through the piece with every motion.  An empty gem setting mars the bracer's appearance slightly.
